segments.comment: Variation of look-once-pick-independent: getpos.c's ':' pick (LOOK_VERBOSE) describes the hero's own square and pager.c do_look() shows the data.base entry without the More-info question (chkfilDontAsk); the two spaces acknowledge the description and dismiss the entry, the loop then asks for another location, which Escape ends before the search.
